title.narrative: EU Trade and Competitiveness Programme for Morocco and Tunisia

description.narrative: In the context of enhancing the trade relations with Morocco and Tunisia, the Programme aims at bringing local trade-related requirements, industrial standards, technical regulations and animal and plant health measures closer to EU legislation. The Programme will support private sector SMEs in Tunisia and Morocco to implement such higher standards through a value chain approach.
